vectors.name: lead-post-thai-multiline-body
vectors.$comment: Pins UTF-8 encoding of the canonical string and a literal newline inside the body. CONFIRMED 2026-08-14: ezy-assets reproduced the signature three ways, one of them a Python implementation written from the documented rule rather than transcribed from any C# (coord #0069); propertiezy recomputed all five canonical strings and signatures independently of its own signer (coord #0068). VERIFIER conformance, not producer: System.Text.Json escapes a newline to \n whatever the encoder, so no .NET producer emits this body — a hand-built body, a non-.NET producer or a rewriting proxy can. The decoded body is deliberately NOT parseable JSON (a raw control character inside a string literal); that is the point, since the newline must be read as data rather than as a fifth canonical field.
